clue.text: A state containing cunning chaotic situation

indicators.note: the state abbreviation holds the word for cunning inside it, wrapped around it

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for the US state of New York
arch means sly or knowingly cunning, as in an arch look

explanation.surface: A country gripped by sly, scheming disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'containing' puts ARCH (cunning) inside NY (New York), after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Anarchy is lawless disorder, a state of political chaos with no government in control.

indicators.note: something manufactured is made up or put together, so the letters of these words are reassembled

explanation.surface: A factory produced a first-class beverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manufactured' rearranges the nine letters of A GRADE ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet fizzy soft drink flavoured with orange.

clue.text: Italian family had three-quarters of the drugs

indicators.note: taking three-quarters of an eight-letter word keeps six letters and loses the final two

parts.note: medicine is a collective word for drugs, as in taking your medicine

explanation.surface: An Italian clan once possessed most of the narcotics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three-quarters of' cuts MEDICINE (the drugs) to its first six letters, dropping NE. The Medici were the ruling family of Renaissance Florence.
explanation.definitionFit: The Medici were the powerful banking dynasty who ruled Florence in the Renaissance.

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker hired for a short period
late means behind schedule, held up

explanation.surface: A stand-in employee turned up late, and this is the outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: A template is a model or guide shape used to make copies, so it serves as a pattern.

clue.text: Making an irreversible decision at the pool?

definitions.text: Making an irreversible decision at the pool?

parts.words: Making an irreversible decision at the pool
parts.note: an idiom for committing yourself to a bold step, read literally as diving into a swimming pool

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means committing to a risky course you cannot back out of, pictured here as a literal dive.

parts.note: the principal meal of the day, with 'at sea' hinting at the main, an old poetic word for the ocean

explanation.definitionFit: The chief meal of the day, often dinner, is called this; the main is also the open ocean.

indicators.note: only some of the letters of gelatinous are taken, a run lying inside the word

explanation.surface: A bit of jelly-like texture on the tongue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' signals a run of letters taken from inside GELATINOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin is the language of ancient Rome, and tongue is a common word for a language.

parts.note: reads like flamboyant theatrical stuff, but means the canvas used at a campsite

explanation.definitionFit: Tentage is tents collectively, or the canvas they are made of, the stuff of a campsite.

clue.text: If it is, don't you believe it

definitions.text: If it is, don't you believe it

parts.words: If it is, don't you believe it
parts.note: a statement that is false should not be believed, and the clue describes that quality

explanation.definitionFit: Something false or inaccurate is something you should not believe.

parts.note: working with needles and yarn to make a garment, a plain description of the activity

explanation.definitionFit: Making fabric by looping yarn on needles is a form of needlework.

clue.text: Bird is in trouble in Italian port

indicators.note: letters in trouble are in disarray, so these words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bird gets into difficulties at a harbour in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges BIRD IS IN; the second 'in' is part of the fodder, not a link. Brindisi is a port on the heel of Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Brindisi is a seaport on the Adriatic coast of southern Italy.

definitions.meaning: done by hand, as in ... labour

explanation.definitionFit: The word means operated by hand, and also a handbook giving instructions.

parts.note: seems to mean being offended, but describes taking possessions dishonestly

explanation.definitionFit: Stealing is taking property by wrongful means.

clue.text: Sort of fee you get for conveyancing?

definitions.text: Sort of fee you get for conveyancing?

parts.words: Sort of fee you get for conveyancing
parts.note: a kind of fee, such as a footballer's move fee, and also the legal handing over of property

explanation.walkthrough: Conveyancing is the British legal work of handing ownership of a house from seller to buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Conveyancing is the legal handover of property ownership; a football club also pays a fee of this name to sign a player.

indicators.note: a collapse throws things into disorder, so the letters of coastline are rearranged

explanation.surface: Part of the shoreline has given way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collapse of' rearranges the letters of COASTLINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sectional means relating to a section or part only, so it is partial rather than whole.

clue.text: Skinhead radioed round from edge of highway

indicators.note: turned round, so the letters are put in a different order

parts.note: the head of the word skin is its first letter, S

explanation.surface: A shaven-headed youth sent a radio message from the hard shoulder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skinhead' gives S, the first letter of 'skin'; 'round' rearranges S with RADIOED.
explanation.definitionFit: The roadside is the strip of land bordering a road.

parts.note: a block on a decision, but also the letters of the word vote set free and rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as an instruction: free (rearrange) VOTE and you get VETO. A free vote is also one where MPs are not told how to vote by their party.
explanation.definitionFit: A free vote is a parliamentary vote cast without party instructions.

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
to prove is to test or try out, as in proving a gun

explanation.surface: Have another go at telling someone off.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove is to scold or reprimand.

clue.text: Pretend to be holding gold coming from another country

indicators.note: the word for pretend holds the word for gold within it

parts.note: to feign is to pretend
or is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Faking possession of bullion brought in from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'holding' puts OR (gold in heraldry) inside FEIGN.
explanation.definitionFit: Foreign means belonging to or originating in another nation.

definitions.meaning: a post or situation of employment

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a location where something sits, and also a post in employment.

parts.note: St is the abbreviation for street, a way
rife means widespread or abounding

explanation.definitionFit: Strife is bitter conflict, a lack of agreement.

indicators.note: the word for rushed goes outside, wrapping round the bill

parts.note: sped means went fast, rushed
ac, short for account, is a bill

explanation.surface: Bill ran out of the house at regular gaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts SPED round AC (account, a bill). 'Bill' looks like a man's name but is an account.
explanation.definitionFit: Things spaced out are set apart with gaps between them.

parts.note: sounds like a university, but means a professor's post, named after the seat

explanation.definitionFit: A professorship at a university is called by the name of a piece of furniture you sit on.

clue.text: Got out of bed and trooped round youth centre first

indicators.note: the centre of youth comes first, ahead of the rearranged letters
the centre of the five-letter word youth is its middle letter
turned round, so the letters of trooped are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone rose and marched round, the young one leading the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre' gives U, the middle letter of YOUTH; 'first' puts it in front; 'round' rearranges TROOPED to PROOTED. The definition is a gardener's bed, not a sleeper's.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant pulled out of a flower bed has been uprooted.

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A gift that comes from those very same folk.
explanation.walkthrough: DO is short for ditto, the word for 'the same as above'.
explanation.definitionFit: A donation is a gift given to a cause, a contribution.

clue.text: Raised edge of pastry case, say, returned

parts.note: a flan is an open pastry case with a filling

indicators.note: returned means the abbreviation for say is read backwards

parts.note: eg, for example, is what 'say' means when offering an example

explanation.surface: The lip of a tart, for example, sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns EG (say) into GE after FLAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A flange is a projecting rim or lip on a wheel or pipe.

parts.note: the French word for behind, also used in English as a jokey word for the bottom

explanation.definitionFit: The word is French for at the back, and in English a polite term for the buttocks.
